name: Karuta
source:
A pure-white Shinigami who appears before the protagonist when he's about to take his life. She reads him the ancient tale of One Thousand and One Nights to help him fall asleep.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
